name: timeline
summary: What happens when and what is stuck: a status finding, status counts, a week-by-week plan with today marked, and a newest-first log.

finish_line.says: one H1, and it states the finding
links a kit tunnel holds (kit v2: kit.css and kit.js), so it renders in every viewer
no stylesheet or script from another host (the kit is ours)
every frame or figure carries its own picture, not a stock block (pages/draw-a-frame)
only at-risk work carries the accent
works at 400px wide and in dark mode
anyone signed out who opens the link (mail, a website, an unfurl) can read it only if it was created with visibility "public"; the default is private and they get 404
